sourceReview.method: Audited upstream ggml-hexagon HTP firmware (process_opbatch and prep_op_bufs at 19cce6919992fdffd92e0ac152caaf1e2b8f254e) to verify that bufs[0].size (image[8..16]) governs CDSP mmap caching while dspqueue_buffer.size governs FastRPC sender cache-flush and recipient cache-invalidation range (flags 0x90). Added dirty_resident_weights tracking to Session in tools/hexagon-native/src/projection_native.rs so the initial submission after prepare_weights flushes the full allocation while subsequent Weights::NativeResident cache-hit submissions scope QueueBuffer.size to the page-aligned active working prefix ((active.output + rows * 4).next_multiple_of(4096) <= 94,208 bytes = 92 KiB). Raised NATIVE_Q2_MAX_RESIDENT_WEIGHT_BYTES from 256 MiB to 480 MiB (503,316,480 bytes, keeping working_bytes + resident_weights = 504,174,592 bytes within ggml-hexagon.dll m-size = 512 MiB), NATIVE_Q2_RESIDENT_METADATA_BYTES to 256 KiB (262,144 bytes), and max_projections to 26 so all 25 PQ2_0 projections of the complete 4-layer repeating block (blk.0 + blk.1 + blk.2 + blk.3, 427,622,400 bytes) fit resident.
sourceReview.scope: Scoped resident QueueBuffer.size cache flush in projection_native.rs, 480 MiB NATIVE_Q2_MAX_RESIDENT_WEIGHT_BYTES in native_q2.rs, 256 KiB NATIVE_Q2_RESIDENT_METADATA_BYTES and 26-projection admission in model_probe.rs, and matching verification in bonsai-tools model_device.rs.

localValidation.focusedControls: 92 Prism unit tests (7 parallel_rows, 39 hexagon-native, 27 hexagon-runtime lib, 19 model_probe bin) and 16 Runner model_device tests passed
localValidation.multiLayer13ProjNativeQ2ScopedFlushSigne: passed 39 logical operations in 39 queue writes across 39 projections (all 6 PQ2_0 projections of recurrent layer blk.0 plus all 7 PQ2_0 projections of full-attention layer blk.3 on tokens 42, 43, 128) with bounded float tolerance pass on all 3 tokens (cosineSimilarity 0.999902-0.999977, rmse 0.0228-0.0290, maxAbsDiff 0.1080-0.1538, top1Match true, top5Overlap 5/5); 13 prepared tensors (212,336,640 bytes in 237,498,368-byte mapping) and 26 cache hits; warm-token nativeCheckedEvaluationMilliseconds dropped from 555.44-586.48 ms (at a383e92) to 422.49-446.20 ms (beating the 4-worker NEON CPU baseline 463.97-478.07 ms on warm tokens 1-2 and 1,386.00 ms vs 1,392.70 ms across all 3 tokens)
localValidation.fourLayer25ProjNativeQ2ResidentSignedCon: passed 75 logical operations in 75 queue writes across 75 projections (all 25 PQ2_0 projections of the complete 4-layer repeating unit blk.0 + blk.1 + blk.2 + blk.3 on tokens 42, 43, 128) with bounded float tolerance pass on all 3 tokens (cosineSimilarity 0.999895-0.999972, rmse 0.0217-0.0316, maxAbsDiff 0.1163-0.1669, top1Match true, top5Overlap 5/5); 25 prepared tensors (427,622,400 bytes in 452,784,128-byte mapping) and 50 cache hits; total NPU submit-and-wait latency 10.0536-10.9094 ms per token across all 25 projections (~0.402-0.436 ms per projection)
localValidation.cleanup: Both controls: four explicit native cleanup return codes zero, allocation freed, required owners pinned until exit, owned Jobs confirmed empty
localValidation.scope: Combined recurrent + full-attention layers (blk.0 + blk.3, 13 projections, 212.34 MB) with scoped cache flush and full 4-layer repeating block (blk.0 + blk.1 + blk.2 + blk.3, 25 projections, 427.62 MB) resident native-q2 1-op controls, tokens 42, 43, 128, standard adapter 1.3, NEON/four row workers. No broader arithmetic/lifecycle or production qualification.

diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.power: Outer workload clock and all control arms observed battery operation (acConnected: false, batterySaver: false, 76% battery charge) throughout the 37.13-second run (within the 300-second predeclared allowance). Because the controls ran on battery power rather than AC power, evaluation wall-clock comparisons are retained as diagnostic observations only and are not qualified as performance comparisons.
diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.interpretation: Scoping dspqueue_buffer.size to the page-aligned active working prefix (<= 92 KiB) on resident cache hits eliminated up to 237.5 MB x 2 of unnecessary FastRPC cache flushes/invalidations per projection on warm tokens, reducing 13-projection warm-token evaluation time from 555.44-586.48 ms (at a383e92) to 422.49-446.20 ms (faster than the 463.97-478.07 ms 4-worker NEON CPU baseline on tokens 1 and 2, and 1,386.00 ms vs 1,392.70 ms across all 3 tokens) with 4.4271-4.8742 ms total NPU submit-and-wait per token (~0.341-0.375 ms per projection). Expanding NATIVE_Q2_MAX_RESIDENT_WEIGHT_BYTES to 480 MiB (503,316,480 bytes) within ggml-hexagon.dll's 512 MiB single-buffer m-size ceiling enabled holding all 25 PQ2_0 projections of the complete 4-layer repeating block (blk.0 + blk.1 + blk.2 + blk.3, 427,622,400 bytes in a 452,784,128-byte FastRPC buffer) resident simultaneously: all 75 operations across 3 tokens completed in 10.0536-10.9094 ms of NPU submit-and-wait per token (~0.402-0.436 ms per projection) with 0.999895-0.999972 cosine similarity, exact top-1 token agreement (1183, 12, 248), and 5/5 top-5 overlap.

defaultBlockers: The published CPU Prism runtime and server have no NPU serving integration. Changing the descriptive admission lock alone cannot enable offload.

A single FastRPC rpcmem buffer is bounded by ggml-hexagon.dll m-size = 512 MiB (currently admitted up to 480 MiB resident weights + 24 MiB working buffer = 504 MiB, holding one full 4-layer repeating unit = 25 projections = 427.62 MB). Holding all 32 layers (8 x 4-layer repeating units, ~3.42 GB packed Q2_0) requires multi-buffer FastRPC arena management across multiple rpcmem FDs (up to the 3000 MiB v81 CDSP virtual address space limit) and/or double-buffered 4-layer block staging.

On Token 0 cold preparation, prepare_weights sets dirty_resident_weights = true before each of the 25 projections, causing 25 full-allocation flushes on Token 0; batch-preparing resident weights before the first submission or bounding dirty flush range to handle.range.end will reduce Token-0 cache-flush cost.
Controls in this session ran on battery power (acConnected: false, 76% charge); AC-powered comparison controls are required for qualified performance claims.
nextConcreteImplementation: Scope dirty resident cache flushes on cold preparation to the newly written weight extent (or batch-prepare resident weights before first submission), and implement multi-buffer FastRPC resident arenas across multiple rpcmem FDs to scale beyond a single 512 MiB m-size buffer across multiple 4-layer repeating blocks.
